get.description: Public. Signed-in callers never get posts they wrote, voted on or commented on. Posts are ordered by: (1) posts sharing a tag with the caller's interest posts (the public posts they wrote, upvoted or commented on), then posts in a category of those posts, then the rest; (2) shared tags, most first; (3) activity in the last 7 days, views + 2 x votes + 3 x comments; (4) vote score, newest, highest id. Anonymous callers and callers without activity get order (3)–(4) only.

200.description: Recommended posts, best first; empty when no post is public

get.description: Public. Tags of published posts, leaving out the caller's interest tags (the tags of the public posts they wrote, upvoted or commented on). Ordered by: (1) public posts carrying the tag and an interest tag, most first; (2) public posts with the tag created in the last 7 days, most first; (3) postCount, most first, then name.

200.description: Recommended tags, best first; empty when no published post has a tag

Public. Published or locked posts and visible comments on them, per UTC day, for the last 7 or 30 UTC days ending with the current, still partial day. Quiet days are returned with 0. Figures count the records that are public now and were created in the window.

post.description: Public, for guests and members. Call it after the post was actually shown to the reader, not for prefetches or background refreshes; reading a post counts nothing by itself. Create a new openingId for each opening and reuse it only to retry that opening: the same openingId is counted once and is safe to retry for at least 24 hours. Answers 204 whether or not this delivery was the one counted.

RecordPostOpeningRequest.description: One intentional opening of a post

ActivityChangeDto.description: One figure in the current window against the previous one

change.description: current - previous; negative for a decrease

changePercent.description: change / previous × 100, rounded half up to 1 decimal; null when previous is 0, since growth from nothing has no percentage

PostOpeningDayDto.description: Openings of the post on one UTC day. A measured day with no openings has openings 0; a day that ended before openings were collected is not measured and has openings null.

measured.description: Whether openings were being collected on this day; the day collection started counts from collectedFrom

openings.description: Intentional openings on this day; null when the day is not measured

PostOpeningTrendDto.description: Daily intentional openings of one of the caller's posts, over the window of the public activity. Counts openings only: no reader, visitor or demographic data.

collectedFrom.description: Openings are collected from this instant on; days that ended before it are not measured

days.description: One row per UTC day, oldest first and ending with the current day; as many rows as the window has days

generatedAt.description: When these figures were read; the current UTC day counts up to this moment

totalOpenings.description: Openings on the measured days of the window

windowEnd.description: Start of the UTC day after the last one, exclusive

windowStart.description: Start of the first UTC day, inclusive

PublicActivityComparisonDto.description: Public activity of the current window against the window of the same length right before it. The current window is that of the public activity up to generatedAt, so its figures equal the activity totals; the previous one ends where it starts, with no gap or overlap, and lasts exactly as long, so the partial current day is matched by an equal span. Figures count the records that are public now, so hiding a post later lowers both windows.

comments.description: Visible comments on public posts: current against previous

current.description: From 00:00 UTC of the first of the period's days, the current one being the last, to generatedAt

generatedAt.description: When these figures were read; the end of the current window

previous.description: The equally long window ending at current.start

PublicActivityWindowDto.description: Public posts and comments created from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive)

comments.description: Visible comments on public posts created in the window

posts.description: Public posts created in the window

PublicCategoryDistributionDto.description: Public posts created in the window by category. The window and the posts counted are those of the public activity, so totalPosts equals its totalPosts and the rows add up to it.

categories.description: Every listed category in display order, then by name, with 0 when it has no posts in the window; a hidden category only when it has posts in the window. The last row has category null and counts the posts without a category; it is always present.

generatedAt.description: When these figures were read; the current UTC day counts up to this moment

totalPosts.description: Public posts created in the window; the denominator of every share

windowEnd.description: Start of the UTC day after the last one, exclusive

windowStart.description: Start of the first UTC day, inclusive

PublicCategoryDto.description: Identity of a category in the public analytics, for drill-down to its posts

id.description: Category ID; the feed filter GET /forum/posts?categoryId= lists its posts

visible.description: Whether the category is listed on the forum; a hidden category has no category page but its public posts still count

PublicCategoryShareDto.description: Public posts of one category created in the window

category.description: The category; null for posts without a category, including posts whose category was deleted

posts.description: Public posts created in the window

share.description: posts / totalPosts as a fraction from 0 to 1, rounded half up to 4 decimals, so the shares can differ from 1 by rounding; null when the window has no public posts
